text: Sam (recruiter): quick one 111 offer to Noel (Senior Infra Eng). Candidate needs to relocate from UK, manager asking for $6,500 sign-on, provisional uplift +6% to base, and benefits active on day 1. Can people-ops route an exception? Priya (people-ops): please post a short bullets summary of asks + why. Also timeline for relocation docs. Sam (recruiter): Ask summary: sign-on $6,500 one-time; provisional uplift +6% (above auto threshold); benefits effective start date. Rationale: competing offer, high priority infra hire, manager expects 4-6 week ramp and product dependency. Candidate can provide passport and UK address by 2026-06-05. Elaine (comp): +6% is above 5% threshold, needs comp committee sign-off unless leader justification is strong; upload manager memo and budget owner approval. Mike (finance): finance needs GL code (confirm 5012) and headcount approval. One-time sign-on can come from hiring budget if leader approves. Note run-rate impact if uplift applied. Anna (legal): day-1 benefits usually ok but need clause on carrier rules and possible retro premiums; I can draft language. Chandra (onboarding): operational constraints: benefits enrollment feed needs 72h lead time; for international relocation we also need proof of right-to-work by start date. If docs not in by 2026-06-02 feed cutoff, coverage may start later. BenefitsBot: Reminder: benefits feed cutoff 72h before start 111 escalate to benefits-team by 2026-05-30 if docs missing. Priya (people-ops): routing I propose: Manager -> People Ops (comp review) -> Finance -> Comp Committee (if compness) -> Legal & Onboarding looped for language and logistics. Target decision by 2026-05-28 to allow offer finalization. Sam (recruiter): uploading manager memo and budget owner email now. Tagging @Elaine @Mike. Elaine (comp): reading memo; if memo shows a clear business impact I will escalate to comp committee for +6% approval; otherwise we may counter at +4%. Mike (finance): finance provisional ok for sign-on; uplift needs approval for run-rate impact. GL 5012 confirmed. Anna (legal): Proposed sentence: "Benefits eligibility and enrollment will commence on the employee's start date, subject to carrier rules and timely submission of verification documents; retroactive coverage is subject to carrier approval." Priya (people-ops): hold until comp committee result; Sam please confirm candidate doc ETA and if candidate will accept an alternative effective date if verification delayed. Sam (recruiter): candidate ok with start window 6/01-6/15 but prefers earlier; will aim to upload docs by 2026-05-27. BenefitsBot: If docs received before 2026-05-29, on-boarding can meet 6/01 effective; otherwise expect delay. Priya (people-ops): Next steps: Sam to attach docs + manager memo; Elaine to post comp committee decision; Mike to mark finance approval; Anna to add clause to offer template; Chandra to queue benefits feed. Target approvals by 2026-05-28. Sam (recruiter): thanks all, will push candidate for docs and update thread.
